## CUTANEOUS CANDIDIASIS
## Inpatient Cutaneous candidiasis is a superficial fungal infection of the epidermis.
Presents with red, erythematous patches, often in areas where skin contacts
skin, including axillae, groin, and abdominal folds.
Keep affected areas dry and clean.
## Treatment
Treat for 4 weeks.
## Inpatient [Clotrimazole 1% cream apply to affected area BID ($) [M]](psjzid-clotrimazole-1-cream-topical-bid)
## Alternative
[Nystatin Cream to affected area BID ($) [M]](psjzid-nystatin-cream-bid)
## Outpatient Clotrimazole 1% cream apply to affected area BID ($) [M]
[Non-VA order for above](pshzid2-clotrim-1-crm-top-bid-28days)
